steps.title: Select appropriate NucleoSpin kit
steps.instruction: Based on the plankton size fraction, use the NucleoSpin Plant II MINI kit for ~20 µm fractions (samples pre‑filtered with a plankton net and collected on 47 mm polycarbonate filters) or the NucleoSpin Plant II MIDI kit for larger fractions.

steps.title: Cut filter and prepare tube
steps.instruction: Cut each 47 mm polycarbonate filter into small pieces, place the pieces into a sterile 2 mL microtube, and clean scissors and tweezers with DNA‑Away between samples.

steps.title: Add proteinase K and lysozyme (Mini)
steps.instruction: For the MINI protocol add 25 µL proteinase K (20 mg mL⁻¹) to the tube, vortex, then add 100 µL lysozyme (20 mg mL⁻¹), vortex and incubate 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add PL1, proteinase K, lysozyme (Midi)
steps.instruction: For the MIDI protocol resuspend filter material with 400 µL pre‑heated buffer PL1 (in a sterile 2 mL tube), add 250 µL proteinase K (20 mg mL⁻¹), vortex, then add 100 µL lysozyme (100 mg mL⁻¹), vortex and incubate 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate lysate at 56 °C
steps.instruction: Seal the tube (or Falcon 15 mL tube) with parafilm, place on a thermomixer and incubate 2 h at 56 °C (900 rpm for MINI; slow shaking for MIDI).

steps.title: Transfer lysate to filter column
steps.instruction: Transfer the lysate (with filter pieces) onto a NucleoSpin filter column (purple). Centrifuge 5 min at 11 000 g (room temperature) for MINI or 10 min at 4 500 g for MIDI.

steps.title: Collect eluate into new tube
steps.instruction: Using a P1000 pipette, transfer the eluate to a new sterile tube (2 mL microtube for MINI; 15 mL Falcon tube for MIDI) without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Bind DNA with buffer PC
steps.instruction: Add buffer PC to the lysate, mix thoroughly (pipette up‑and‑down 5 times for MINI; vortex 30 s for MIDI). Then transfer the precipitate onto the binding column (650 µL onto a green MINI column, max 650 µL; or 3.5 mL onto a Plant Midi column, max 4 mL). Centrifuge 1 min at 11 000 g (MINI) or 2 min at 4 500 g (MIDI). Discard flow‑through and keep the column on the collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the loading step until all lysate has been applied.

steps.title: Wash column with PW1 buffer
steps.instruction: Add buffer PW1 (400 µL for MINI; 1 mL for MIDI) to the membrane, centrifuge 1 min at 11 000 g (MINI) or 2 min at 4 500 g (MIDI). Discard flow‑through and keep the column on the collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with PW2 buffers
steps.instruction: For MINI: add 675 µL buffer PW2, centrifuge 1 min at 11 000 g; then add 200 µL buffer PW2, centrifuge 2 min at 11 000 g, discard flow‑through and the collection tube, and place the column in a new sterile 1.5 mL microtube (labeled). For MIDI: add 3 mL buffer PW2, centrifuge 2 min at 4 500 g; then add 1 mL buffer PW2, centrifuge 10 min at 4 500 g, discard flow‑through and the collection tube, and place the column in a new sterile 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA with preheated PE
steps.instruction: Pre‑heat buffer PE to 65 °C. Add buffer PE (50 µL for MINI; 150 µL for MIDI) onto the membrane, incubate 5 min at 65 °C in the thermomixer, then centrifuge (1 min at 11 000 g for MINI; 2 min at 4 500 g for MIDI). Repeat the PE addition once more to increase DNA concentration.

steps.title: Transfer eluate and store DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluted DNA to a sterile 1.5 mL microtube (or appropriate tube) that is correctly labeled with sample name, date, and operator. Measure DNA concentration with a Nanodrop or Qubit, and store the DNA at –20 °C (or –80 °C for long‑term storage).
